scripts.build: bun run --filter @better-typescript/matchers build && bun run --filter @better-typescript/core build && bun run --filter @better-typescript/guidance build && bun run --filter @better-typescript/cli build && bun run --filter @better-typescript/workflows build
scripts.typecheck: bun run build && tsc --noEmit -p tests/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.selfhost.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/extend-preset/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/architecture-fleets/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/programmatic/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test --timeout 30000 tests/*.test.ts
